basic_info.description: Remodeled two-level condo nestled in a prime Noe Valley location, steps to the 24th Street corridor with cafes, restaurants, public transportation/tech bus routes, and essential stops for everyday errands. An open main level features a living room and dining room connect to a spacious, modern kitchen with a walk-in pantry. A half bath completes the main level. Downstairs, more living space is offer by a family room/den, great for home office or guests. Across the hall are two bedrooms with green garden out looks, a full bathroom and an en-suite bathroom. Off the primary, a deeded patio awaits with access to the shared garden. Back inside, an in-unit laundry completes this wonderful, move-in ready condo.
